pr_title: Add `nmi` (nautical miles) as valid distance unit

issue_context.title: HA thinks that nautical miles are wrong unit for class distance
issue_context.body:
### The problem

I've configured entity with class "distance" and set unit for that entity to "nm" (nautical miles) but HA doesn't like that.

`2024-08-25 21:37:31.780 WARNING (MainThread) [homeassistant.components.sensor] Entity sensor.fr24_zasieg_maksymalny (<class 'homeassistant.components.mqtt.sensor.MqttSensor'>) is using native unit of measurement 'nm' which is not a valid unit for the device class ('distance') it is using; expected one of ['mi', 'ft', 'in', 'm', 'yd', 'cm', 'km', 'mm']; Please update your configuration if your entity is manually configured, otherwise create a bug report at https://github.com/home-assistant/core/issues?q=is%3Aopen+is%3Aissue+label%3A%22integration%3A+mqtt%22`



### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

core-2024.8.3

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

_No response_

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant Container

### Integration causing the issue

mosquitto

### Link to integration documentation on our website

_No response_

### Diagnostics information

`2024-08-25 21:37:31.780 WARNING (MainThread) [homeassistant.components.sensor] Entity sensor.fr24_zasieg_maksymalny (<class 'homeassistant.components.mqtt.sensor.MqttSensor'>) is using native unit of measurement 'nm' which is not a valid unit for the device class ('distance') it is using; expected one of ['mi', 'ft', 'in', 'm', 'yd', 'cm', 'km', 'mm']; Please update your configuration if your entity is manually configured, otherwise create a bug report at https://github.com/home-assistant/core/issues?q=is%3Aopen+is%3Aissue+label%3A%22integration%3A+mqtt%22`



### Example YAML snippet

```yaml
- name: FR24 Zasięg Maksymalny                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       
    unique_id: fr24maxrange                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            
    device_class: distance                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             
    unit_of_measurement: "nm"                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          
    state_topic: "/fr24/xxx/maxrange"
```


### Anything in the logs that might be useful for us?

_No response_

### Additional information

_No response_
comments:
the error is correct `nm` is not a valid unit that HA expects, even mentioned in the docs which units are supported.

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/sensor/#device-class

`distance: Generic distance in km, m, cm, mm, mi, yd, or in`

you can follow the existing feature request for this:

https://community.home-assistant.io/t/add-nautical-miles-as-a-valid-unit-for-distance-device-class/754284

review_comments: Nautical miles is two words. Please separate them with underscore in the attribute name.
